river_navigation_works.name: River Navigation Works
river_navigation_works.description: Maintained channels, towpaths and landing places support navigation and the surrounding cultivated land. Completing the works improves the connected river routes.

canal_lock_works.name: Canal and Lock Works
canal_lock_works.description: Locks, sluices and bypass channels improve difficult waterway connections. Completing the works improves the connected river routes.

caoyun_canal_office.name: Caoyun Canal Office
caoyun_canal_office.description: Canal officials, dredging crews and sluice keepers maintain waterways used by the grain transport system. Completing the works improves the connected river routes.

lowland_sluice_works.name: Lowland Sluice Works
lowland_sluice_works.description: Sluice keepers and water boards coordinate drainage and passage through the lowland waterways. Completing the works improves the connected river routes.

nile_navigation_works.name: Nile Canal and Basin Works
nile_navigation_works.description: Canal keepers maintain the channels connecting the Nile, cultivated basins and river landings. Completing the works improves the connected river routes. Cataracts remain impassable.

delta_waterway_works.name: Delta Waterway Works
delta_waterway_works.description: Dredged distributaries, landing channels and embankments sustain transport through the delta. Completing the works improves the connected river routes.

starting_evidence.note: Regional allocation of surviving irrigation improvement levels to maintained grain-navigation infrastructure; individual buildings are inferred, not surveyed.
Basin irrigation and channel maintenance, not modern barrages or an open cataract route.
Water-board authority documented from 1289. No industrial canals or steam drainage.

notes: Regional variants replace existing Irrigation Systems levels one-for-one; identical capacity per level.
Only documented regional starting envelopes receive automatic placement, and only if an eligible existing family level is available.
Physical conversion thresholds and road costs live in the World Builder navigation configuration and handover.
